name: KG finding cluster resolver (distill redundant findings)
notes: Reads pending findings, groups by primary_node_id, calls kg_finding_cluster_resolver to verify which candidate clusters share ONE root question. Confirmed leads get synthesized root_question; siblings get superseded_by stamped (hidden from default UI). Resolving a lead cascades to its siblings. Runs after wiki_nightly_refresh (03:00) so wiki_contradiction findings of the same night are eligible for clustering.
